title: Ember provenance receipt v1 (loop/graph substrate, issue #1309)
description: Extends receipts/INDEX.jsonl's existing flat, append-only shape by making every field except claim_fields mandatory, and adding node_id as the join key back into the execution graph. Matches the approved loop/graph substrate schema sketch, section 3 (workstream B, issue #1309). One JSON object per line (JSONL), append-only.

node_id.description: Join key back into the execution graph. The single field missing from every real INDEX.jsonl row sampled in audit-v1.md.

claim_fields.description: Free-form escape hatch matching existing INDEX.jsonl rows that carry arbitrary claim payloads.
